review: findings:3

- Major, [BulkBindingsRegistrar.php:87](/home/vostrikov/projects/packages/corex/packages/operations/src/Bulk/Laravel/BulkBindingsRegistrar.php:87): The singleton failure-reader callback retains its original application, so after switching tenant containers it resolves tenant A’s scoped `BulkTransferFactory` for tenant B’s failure reads.
- Major, [MediaOperationStore.php:259](/home/vostrikov/projects/packages/corex/packages/media/src/Internal/MediaOperationStore.php:259), [DeliveryStore.php:195](/home/vostrikov/projects/packages/corex/packages/notifications/src/Delivery/Internal/DeliveryStore.php:195): Both helpers interpret timezone-less database timestamps in PHP’s default timezone, so with a UTC clock and `America/New_York` timezone, already-due media and SQLite notification rows are selected but their claims are refused for approximately four hours.
- Major, [runtime-globals-gate.php:457](/home/vostrikov/projects/packages/corex/scripts/runtime-globals-gate.php:457): Alias resolution still misses valid namespace and case-insensitive aliases, allowing `use Illuminate\Support as Support; Support\Facades\DB::table('x')` and `use Carbon\CarbonImmutable as Moment; MOMENT::now()` outside the Laravel bridge without G1/G3 findings.
